altPaidOutFormula: noninterest expense 54.842 − D&A 1.7 − stock comp 1.476 + income taxes paid 1.419 (USD billions)
notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0000072971-26-000133; financial statements in wfc-20251231.htm). Bank: paidOut null, altPaidOut = noninterest expense − D&A − SBC + income taxes paid. Operating cash flow was negative (−19,001), driven by trading and loans-held-for-sale flows, which is why the formula is not used. D&A is premises-and-equipment depreciation (1.7bn as stated in the accounting-policy note, the DepreciationAndAmortization fact); the cash-flow add-back 'Depreciation, amortization and accretion' includes securities and loan accretion and is not comparable, so it is not used. SBC is the stock-based compensation credited to paid-in capital (1,476, the ShareBasedCompensation fact). The cash-flow statement has no premises-and-equipment purchase line, so capex is null. Interest paid (39,806) is shown separately.
